content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 11 vacancies are available – 3 for Assistant Professor, Political Science, 3 for Assistant Professor, History, 3 for Assistant Professor, Economics, and 2 for Assistant Professor, Library and Information Science.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AMU Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AMU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Aligarh Muslim University (AMU). It is a central university located in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, known for its academic excellence and diverse programs.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Assistant Professor. These positions are available in various subjects within the education field, offering a great career opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies for the Assistant Professor posts. These vacancies are distributed across different subjects like Political Science, History, Economics, and Library and Information Science.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for AMU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the AMU Assistant Professor recruitment is 06 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the AMU Assistant Professor recruitment is online. Candidates need to visit the official careers portal of Aligarh Muslim University to fill out and submit their applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in the concerned subject, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or a Ph.D. degree. A Ph.D. from a top 500 foreign university is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position at AMU?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Professor position will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month. This is a contract-based appointment for the specified duration.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for AMU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All candidates applying for the Assistant Professor posts are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-. The fee must be paid online through the university's careers portal during the application process.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor posts at AMU?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the submission of both online and printed applications with relevant documents, followed by an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job location for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The job location for the Assistant Professor positions is Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh. The appointments will be at Aligarh Muslim University, a prominent educational institution in the state.
